column7: AUTH-2 item 2 (AUTH-PW-BUDGET, from HARDEN-HTTP-1 #3321 inventory): ChangePassword and UpdateOwnProfile's email change checked the current password with a bare bcrypt comparison, so a stolen session or PAT could guess it with no bound. They now go through verifyCurrentPassword (same counter and semantics as a password login). Red on main: wrong guesses never locked the account. Siblings: TestCurrentPassword_SharesTheLoginCounter, TestCurrentPassword_RecheckFaultCostsTheSameAsAWrongPassword, TestChangePassword_SecondFactorAccountDoesNotClear.
